import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Define colors for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 0].scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                       label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
                       color=colors[species])
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 1].scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                       label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
                       color=colors[species])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Box plots for all measurements
measurement_cols = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', value_vars=measurement_cols, 
                     var_name='measurement', value_name='value')

# Map measurement names to readable labels
label_map = {
    'sepal_length': 'Sepal\nLength',
    'sepal_width': 'Sepal\nWidth',
    'petal_length': 'Petal\nLength',
    'petal_width': 'Petal\nWidth'
}
df_melted['measurement'] = df_melted['measurement'].map(label_map)

sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='measurement', y='value', hue='species', 
            ax=axes[1, 0], palette=colors)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot for petal length
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', ax=axes[1, 1], 
               palette=colors, inner='box')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Analysis: Comprehensive Visualization', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
